countries.name: Australia

indicators.name: Territorial fossil CO2 emitted
indicators.scope: Territorial fossil-fuel combustion/oxidation and cement production; excludes international aviation/shipping bunkers. Publisher geographic definitions apply.

source.title: Global Carbon Budget 2025 country workbook — public v0.3

trend.note: Calculated from the same territorial series: 0.6% annual change. This describes fossil CO2 emissions only, not an overall country rating.

indicators.limitations: Public workbook v0.3, not the final v1.0 release. 2024 country data is not the 2025 world projection. Multiply MtC by 3.664 million for tonnes CO2. National territories exclude international bunkers; country totals are not forced to equal the world baseline. Uniform-rate estimate, not live events.

indicators.name: Gross forest area deforested
indicators.scope: FAO reporting geography: Australia (source code 036). Gross deforestation, not net forest-area change or a count of trees.

source.title: FAO Global Forest Resources Assessment 2025 — country intervals
source.flagDescription: Normal value, official data reported by country/area
source.exportDateMeaning: Download date, not publication or observation date

indicators.limitations: Historical interval average. Flag A: official country-reported data; still a reported annual average. Blank more-recent periods remain missing, not zero. Same-period forest expansion: 604,180 hectares/year; gross deforestation alone does not establish net forest decline. Uniform-rate approximation.
indicators.qualityNote: Flag A: official country-reported annual average

indicators.name: Food waste generated — 3 sectors
indicators.scope: Households (HHS) + food service/out-of-home consumption (OOHC) + retail (RTL). Includes inedible parts; excludes pre-retail production/manufacturing losses.

source.title: UN SDG database, AG_FOOD_WST — matched three-sector country data
source.method: Sum HHS + OOHC + RTL; never use ALL

trend.note: A comparable trend is not established from different editions and study methods.

indicators.limitations: All three sector estimates have UNEP High or Medium Confidence. Underlying study years vary; estimates are normalized to 2022 population and are not all directly measured in 2022. ALL totals are not used because they can include additional production/manufacturing sectors. Definition-differs (D) records are excluded. Uniform-rate estimate, not live events.

observations.name: Forest expansion — annual average
observations.scope: FAO forest expansion in the same interval as gross deforestation. This is context, not an additional ticking harm counter.

source.title: FAO FRA 2025 — same-period forest expansion

observations.limitations: Expansion and gross deforestation are separate flows. Neither by itself is net forest-area change. Source flags and interval series are retained in source data.

coverageNotes: Separate source periods and geographic definitions apply. These gauges are not a country ranking or an overall worsening score.
